title: Opening and Kimball's name
summary: Recording notes, date of 25 Nov 1961, and why Kimball was called Henry Kimball Jr. though his name is Narvin.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: I'll make a note that we're recording an interview with Mr. Narvin Kimball out at 3537 Calhoun, and the date is November, let me think, what it is, is it 24th?

25th already, 1961. And this is Bill Russell. Do you mind giving your full name? Narvin Henry Kimball. I noticed in the old times, a lot of times people would call you Henry Kimball Jr., and your father, was his name also Narvin?
No, his name was Henry. Just Henry. And they would call me Henry because of my father. They would call me Little Henry, or they would call me Henry Kimball Jr.
So for a long time I didn't even know your name was Narvin, your first name.
